texts.characters:
The best of
San Diego is right here

The San Diego on our doorstep includes the city’s favorite neighborhoods and attractions – and best of all, you can walk to them. From the harbor and Seaport Village to the Museum of Contemporary Art, Little Italy and the Gaslamp, the past, future and excitement of the city are yours to discover.
